dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: I just feel there are some subtle changes underway with Fontaine's legal systems and judicial processes.

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: I've been to other nations and studied their systems. And since, I've come to find our theatrical trials less and less bearable.

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: But I do think there's been less theatrics lately. Our visitors seem to be coming to learn about the law, rather than to see a spectacle.

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: Or am I wrong? I'll have to keep observing.
